sloka: निवेदितौ च तत्त्वेन सुग्रीवाय महात्मने ।तयोरन्योन्यसंलापाद्भृशं प्रीतिरजायत ।। ५.३५.३२।।।।
transliteration: niveditau ca tattvena sugrīvāya mahātmane ।tayoranyonyasaṁlāpādbhṛśaṁ prītirajāyata ।। 5.35.32।।।।

translations.english: "I reported faithfully about both the highsouled men to Sugriva. As they got to know each other through conversation a fast friendship developed between them.
